frame: Millimetres. Origin at the housing centre; +y up along the long axis (cable end up, skin face down at y = −H/2); +z out of the front face (the face with the label plate); +x to the right when looking at the front face, so the drawing's 'left side' is at x = −W/2. QuSpin's drawing axis Z+ points down, towards the skin face.
